observations: Photo 0: Black DSLR body with 'Canon' and 'EOS 600D' printed on front, paired with a Canon EFS 18-55mm lens, body cap on, shown on a white shelf.
Photo 1: Same body from the back, flip-out LCD screen visible but screen is off/blank, control dials and buttons visible, no power-on indicator shown.

Photo 2: Wider shelf shot showing the same 600D plus a second camera labeled 'Canon EOS 700D', another lens, and a Nikon lens cap in the background, suggesting this is a reseller's general stock photo rather than a shot of only the exact unit being sold.
No shots of the camera powered on, no LCD display lit, no shutter count screen, no battery/charger, no memory card, and no sample images shown.
No visible UK import stickers, customs marks, or seller shop stamps that would substantiate 'UK used' claim.

claims.evidence: No import marking, customs sticker, or UK-specific packaging visible in any photo.
Body looks cosmetically clean in photo 0 and 1, but 'sharp' implies image/optical quality which cannot be judged without a sample photo or video from the camera.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or may have sensor/shutter faults
risks.proof: A video of the camera powering on, showing live view on the LCD and a test shutter fire

risks.risk: Shutter actuation count unknown, could be heavily used despite cosmetic condition
risks.proof: A photo of the shutter count from Canon EOS Utility or a third-party shutter-count checker screen

risks.risk: LCD screen shown closed/off in photo 1, functionality not confirmed
risks.proof: A photo or video with the screen powered on displaying menu or live view

risks.risk: Lens (EFS 18-55mm) optical condition unknown — possible fungus, scratches, or focus issues
risks.proof: Close-up photos of front and rear lens elements under light, plus a focus-test shot
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens condition unverified/worst case

risks.risk: Battery, charger, and memory card not shown — may not be included
risks.proof: A photo of the included battery, charger, and card alongside the camera
risks.if_unproven: priced as body+lens only, no accessories

risks.risk: Photo 2 shows multiple cameras together, raising doubt whether this exact unit is the one being sold or just a stock/shelf photo
risks.proof: A photo of the specific unit alone with a handwritten note/date or seller's name visible
risks.if_unproven: priced cautiously as stock-photo risk, exact unit unconfirmed

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on with LCD live view and shutter fire sound
Screenshot or photo of the shutter actuation count
Close-up photos of the lens front/rear elements for fungus or scratches
Photo of the included battery, charger, and memory card
A single clear photo of only this exact camera (not the shelf with other units) to confirm which unit is for sale
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly readable in the photos, but functionality, shutter count, lens clarity, UK-import claim, and accessory inclusion are all unverified, so the item must be priced at its worst-case condition (body+lens only, unconfirmed working state) until further proof is given.
